# egui default font notices

Unmodified license/notice texts from the crates.io package
`epaint_default_fonts` version 0.37.0, bundled through egui's explicit
`default_fonts` feature. Cargo.lock records the package checksum.

Upstream source: [egui 0.37.0 fonts](https://github.com/emilk/egui/tree/0.37.0/crates/epaint_default_fonts/fonts).
These notices accompany the embedded font assets; no font bytes are duplicated here.
Retain these texts with any distributed native application that includes those assets.

- Hack: MIT and Bitstream Vera notices in `Hack-Regular.txt`.
- Ubuntu Light: Ubuntu Font Licence in `UFL.txt`.
- Noto Emoji: SIL Open Font License in `OFL.txt`.
- Emoji icon font: MIT notice in `emoji-icon-font-mit-license.txt`.
- egui icons: upstream attribution in `egui-icons.txt`.
